Palette: warm white, light oak, soft sage green, natural daylight. An Australian laundry with two clearly different washing machines side by side on a tiled floor, each standing freely with nothing above them. On the LEFT: a white FRONT-LOADING washing machine with a large round glass door on its front. On the RIGHT: a white TOP-LOADING washing machine with a flat hinged lid on top and no door on the front, its lid closed. Between them a narrow gap. Behind them a white wall with a single open shelf higher up holding woven baskets and folded towels. Light timber laundry tub cabinet at the far right edge. Straight-on view, soft daylight.
